BiblicalUsage: Raqqach is a male perfumer, an apothecary. When the wall was rebuilt, 'Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries.'
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the apothecary built the wall: the men who compounded ointments took up trowels, and God's work is done by whatever hands are willing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
